automationNotes: Doc: App Switcher → Personalize → **Projects** list → open project → top nav lists **Experiences**, **Audiences**, **Attributes**, **Events**, **Settings** → **Settings** → **General** (**Project Details**: Name/Description/`UID`; **Save** applies changes). Doc also describes **Reset** (discard) — automation follows **Save** only after edits so changes persist. **Users**: left nav **Users** → list **Status** / **Role** columns.**Invite User** subsection is not automated here (needs a deterministic invite target). Which project opens: substring **`PERSONALIZE_PROJECT_CARD_CONTAINS`** or **`DAL_PERSONALIZE_PROJECT_SEARCH`** (fallback **`Doc Personalize Project`**). DOM: `data/dom/Personalize/personalize-projects.html`, `settings-general.html`, `settings-users.html`. Handlers: `rules/core/actionRules.ts` (`manage-personalize-project`).
